evidence: drpfenderson highly recommends ArchiveBox after years of successful use. flippant also praises years of use but says self-hosting and maintenance become annoying.

evidence_sources.author: drpfenderson
evidence_sources.excerpt: If you're making archiving a more involved part of your workflow, I highly recommend ArchiveBox. It can save pretty much every type of file from everywhere, in almost every format you can imagine, while building a searchable index of the archives. Been using it successfully for many years:

evidence_sources.author: flippant
evidence_sources.excerpt: I used ArchiveBox for years. It's really good. The self-hosting and maintenance gets annoying after a while though.

source_story_title: If you love a website, back it up
